sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'
SELECT globalTid, count(*) calls, sum(end-start) duration_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME WHERE start >= ? AND end <= ? GROUP BY globalTid
SELECT deviceId,copyKind,count(*) calls,sum(bytes) bytes,sum(end-start) duration_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY WHERE start >= ? AND end <= ? GROUP BY deviceId,copyKind
SELECT globalTid, count(*) calls, sum(end-start) duration_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME WHERE start >= ? AND end <= ? GROUP BY globalTid
SELECT deviceId,copyKind,count(*) calls,sum(bytes) bytes,sum(end-start) duration_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY WHERE start >= ? AND end <= ? GROUP BY deviceId,copyKind

SELECT s.value name,count(*) calls,sum(r.end-r.start) duration_ns,max(r.end-r.start) max_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r JOIN StringIds s ON s.id=r.nameId GROUP BY s.value ORDER BY duration_ns DESC

SELECT r.globalTid,s.value name,count(*) calls,min(r.start) start_ns,max(r.end) end_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME r LEFT JOIN ThreadNames t ON t.globalTid=r.globalTid LEFT JOIN StringIds s ON s.id=t.nameId GROUP BY r.globalTid
SELECT deviceId,copyKind,count(*) calls,sum(bytes) bytes,sum(end-start) duration_ns FROM CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY GROUP BY deviceId,copyKind
SELECT severity,text,count(*) count FROM DIAGNOSTIC_EVENT GROUP BY severity,text ORDER BY count(*) DESC
SELECT id,uuid,name FROM TARGET_INFO_GPU ORDER BY id
SELECT s.value name,count(*) calls,sum(r.end-r.start) duration_ns FROM OSRT_API r JOIN StringIds s ON s.id=r.nameId GROUP BY s.value ORDER BY duration_ns DESC
